data.title: CFTC proposes new rule excluding casino gambling, defining event contracts as swaps for sports, politics, culture, weather.
data.description: A new rule is being proposed to include event contracts related to sports, politics, culture, and weather within the "swap" definition. Additionally, an interim rule has been implemented to exclude casino-style gambling from this definition. This move solidifies the agency's authority in this area, showcasing its exclusive jurisdiction over these types of contracts. This development underscores the significance of defining and regulating these contracts in the financial landscape.

data.title: Filippo Fagnani from Quanta System Receives the EAU Award for Significant Contribution to Endourology at ICE 2026
data.description: In Valencia, Spain, Filippo Fagnani, Marketing & Scientific Director of Quanta System’s Surgical Division, was recently awarded the Award for Significant Contribution to Endourology at ICE26. This prestigious recognition was given at the International Conference on Endourology by the EAU Endourology Section. Fagnani was honored for his dedication to laser technology for over 20 years and his unwavering commitment to meeting the evolving needs of urologists. His career has been focused on translating these needs into precise solutions.

data.title: Physicists predict AI chatbots' shift from good to bad using formula; tests on smaller models show accuracy.
data.description: Researchers at George Washington University have developed a formula that predicts when an AI chatbot will transition from providing accurate responses to inaccurate ones. Initial tests on smaller models have shown promising results.

data.title: AI Made Music Fast. CITY JAM Founder Pat Villaceran Says the Real Asset Is the Artist's Own Sound
data.description: In the bustling city of New York, the music industry is witnessing a rapid advancement in AI technology, leading to a surge in the speed and volume of music production. However, amidst this trend, CITY JAM's INDUSTRY.AIFF is focusing on a unique approach - tapping into the creativity of human musicians to produce original sounds that cannot be replicated by any automated pipeline. As of October 10, 2026, the competition in AI-generated music is primarily centered around the rate at which music can be generated and the sheer volume being produced. This shift highlights the ongoing balance between technological innovation and the irreplaceable touch of human artistry in the realm of music creation.
